video_title: Knicks SWEEPING is More Surprising than Spurs in NBA Finals?!

quotes.speaker: Jerry Stackhouse
quotes.summary_phrase: Jerry Stackhouse on the rarity of small guards leading championship teams
quotes.excerpt: When you look back in history, it hasn't been a lot of small guards to do it.
quotes.quote: When you look back in history, it hasn't been a lot of small guards to do it. I think you look at Isaiah Thomas, and probably before all of us, my brother is always talking about Gus Williams with Seattle way back. He was 6'2", he won a championship, but most of the guys weren't able to get it done. It was more about the supporting cast. When you think when AI went, he just didn't have the supporting cast to beat Shaq and Kobe.

quotes.speaker: Jerry Stackhouse
quotes.summary_phrase: Jerry Stackhouse on Jalen Brunson's unique impact in New York
quotes.excerpt: What he's been able to do in New York has been magical.
quotes.quote: Jalen is different. I don't think any of us probably saw this when he left Dallas. I thought he was really good and I've always been a fan of him. I coached against him in AAU when he was 13. But what he's been able to do in New York has been magical. If he's able to pull this off, he's definitely going to go down as one of the best small guards ever.

quotes.speaker: Jerry Stackhouse
quotes.summary_phrase: Jerry Stackhouse, Chandler Parsons, and Lou Williams debate small guard height
quotes.excerpt: Steph is about 6'3". Jalen Brunson is 6'2".

text_blocks.speaker: Chandler Parsons
text_blocks.text: Stack, you're not putting Steph in your small guard category along with us.

text_blocks.speaker: Jerry Stackhouse
text_blocks.text: Steph is about 6'3". To me, Jalen Brunson is 6'2".

text_blocks.speaker: Lou Williams
text_blocks.text: They just want to argue with me this morning. Are you a small guard, Lou? Are you a small guard?

text_blocks.speaker: Chandler Parsons
text_blocks.text: That's why I'm touching them so hard.

quotes.speaker: Jerry Stackhouse
quotes.summary_phrase: Jerry Stackhouse on the Knicks' team chemistry and success
quotes.excerpt: Everything kind of coming together. It's a long season, you're going to have highs and lows.
quotes.quote: I think it's great stories. The way the Knicks have kind of come together, I would love to see this story. As a coach, you want to feel like your team has that message of playing well at the right time. Everything kind of coming together. It's a long season, you're going to have highs and lows, and it just feels like they found a way to come together at the right time. Bridges, OG, all these guys are playing at a high level.

quotes.speaker: Jerry Stackhouse
quotes.summary_phrase: Jerry Stackhouse on defensive strategies to slow down Victor Wembanyama
quotes.excerpt: You have more success when you're able to get under him.
quotes.quote: We had Draymond, so we had a little bit of an advantage. We had somebody that was going to fight him for all his positions. But I think you have more success when you're able to get under him. He wants to put the ball on the floor, he wants to get to the basket, so you may be putting a smaller guy. I thought even Caruso had some success on him because he was under him and wasn't able to allow him to just put the ball on the floor. Even Hartenstein, you saw that he went to really trying to rough him up and getting physical with him.

quotes.speaker: Jerry Stackhouse
quotes.summary_phrase: Jerry Stackhouse on Jalen Brunson's status in New York
quotes.excerpt: I don't think Jalen Brunson would pay for a meal in New York ever again.
quotes.quote: I don't think Jalen Brunson would pay for a meal in New York ever again if he pulls this off. But I think it's just the way they've done it. Made a big change last year with Thibs and bringing in Mike Brown. All of the noise during the course of the year, Mike was getting fired if they didn't get to the finals. New York is one of the toughest places to play and coach because of the fan base and what they expect.

quotes.speaker: Jerry Stackhouse
quotes.summary_phrase: Jerry Stackhouse on Jalen Brunson's early development
quotes.excerpt: He's special, he's a winner, and I love to see it happen for him.
quotes.quote: I remember this kid when he was 13 years old. Most kids, if you come and build a low man on him, you're going to have success. We were coming and building the low man on him at 13 and he was still side-stepping and getting around us. He's special, he's a winner, and I love to see it happen for him.

quotes.speaker: Jerry Stackhouse
quotes.summary_phrase: Jerry Stackhouse on the 2006 NBA Finals suspension
quotes.excerpt: If I don't foul Shaq so hard and get suspended for Game 5, we're winning this thing.

text_blocks.speaker: Chandler Parsons
text_blocks.text: Do you ever look back and think, damn, if I don't foul Shaq so hard and get suspended for Game 5, we're winning this thing?

text_blocks.speaker: Jerry Stackhouse
text_blocks.text: Absolutely. That's one I got to live with. I hate it, but I had to. I thought it was going to be worse. You got to be big fella to the spot though. Either that or he's going to take you with him. That was my thought process and I didn't even get kicked out of the game. So I think so, never did I think that I would get suspended for the next game, and that was probably one of the hardest things to do, to sit in the hotel and watch your team.
